what_good_reporting_should_include: Treatment, outcome, cost, and target population are explicit.
Effect modifiers and controls are assigned before fitting.
Imputation is learned from training data only.
Raw gaps, balance, and propensity overlap are reviewed.
Treatment and outcome models have held-out diagnostics.
Results are not tied to one estimator by default.
CATE estimates are translated into net decision value.
Bootstrap intervals or comparable uncertainty summaries are included.
Assumptions and validation needs are written plainly.
